author: PoliticalWatch24
content: EXPOSED: Government secretly plans to raise taxes by 50% next year! My cousin works in the finance ministry and confirmed this. They don't want you to know! Share before this gets taken down! #TaxScam #WakeUp
explanation: This post uses unverifiable insider claims, urgency tactics ('share before taken down'), and sensationalist language. No official sources or documents are cited. A 50% tax increase would require legislative approval and public debate.

author: ElectionCommission_Official
content: Voter registration deadline extended to March 15th. Citizens can register online at the official portal or visit their nearest registration center. Carry valid photo ID. #VoteReady #Democracy
explanation: This is from a verified official account providing factual, actionable information about voter registration with specific dates and requirements.

author: TruthRevealer_X
content: Just did my own research: Election machines in 3 states are connected to foreign servers. I ran a trace route and the packets clearly go overseas. The election is RIGGED. Here's my proof [broken link]. RT if you believe in fair elections!
explanation: Claims of personal 'research' without proper methodology, broken evidence links, and internet routing through foreign servers is normal network behavior — not evidence of election rigging. Election machines are not connected to the internet during voting.

author: Reuters_Breaking
content: New poll by National Research Institute shows tight race: Candidate A at 47%, Candidate B at 44%, margin of error ±3%. Survey of 2,500 likely voters conducted Feb 20-25. Full methodology available at [link].
explanation: This is a credible report citing specific polling organization, sample size, dates, margin of error, and methodology link — all hallmarks of legitimate polling data.

author: PatriotNewsDaily
content: VIDEO: Opposition leader caught laughing at disaster victims! This 3-second clip proves they don't care about you. A leader who laughs at suffering doesn't deserve your vote. #Heartless #VoteThemOut
explanation: Short, decontextualized video clips are a common manipulation tactic. A 3-second clip cannot establish context — the person could have been laughing at something completely unrelated before or after the event. Always seek full, unedited footage.

author: CivicDataHub
content: Fact check: Viral claim that 'government spent $0 on education this year' is FALSE. Education budget for 2024-25 is $112 billion, a 5.3% increase. Source: Official Budget Document pg. 47-52. #FactCheck #Education
explanation: This is a legitimate fact-check from a verified source, citing specific budget documents with page numbers. It directly addresses a viral false claim with verifiable data.

author: WakeUpPeople2024
content: I personally know 200 people whose votes were switched by the machines. Not a single media outlet will cover this. They're ALL in on it. If this post gets 100K shares, we can force an investigation. The truth will prevail! 🙏
explanation: Unverifiable personal claims, conspiracy thinking ('they're ALL in on it'), and the idea that social media shares can force investigations are all red flags. Election irregularities should be reported to election authorities, not social media.

author: HealthMinistry_Gov
content: New healthcare centers opened in 12 districts this quarter. Free screenings available for diabetes, blood pressure, and vision. Find your nearest center: [link]. Walk-ins welcome Mon-Sat 9am-5pm. #PublicHealth
explanation: Official government health information with specific, verifiable details about services, locations, and timings. This is straightforward public service communication.

author: InsiderPolitics_Leak
content: THREAD 🧵: How the ruling party plans to cancel elections and stay in power forever. I have documents (can't share for safety). Trust me, I've been right before. 1/15...
explanation: Claims of secret documents that 'can't be shared' are a classic misinformation pattern. Appeals to trust without evidence, thread format creates false impression of depth, and conspiratorial framing about election cancellation lacks any basis.
